summary: Iteration 3 — full E2E verification of the Darkinator /single-page-app rebrand with injected Mayan-style swap widget (Private route, Privacy swap, Track) served through the Bifrost v1 proxy of app.veilit.xyz. BACKEND: 16/16 pytest tests pass (bifrost health/meta, brand assets, HTML passthrough + URL rewrite, indexer/relayer/rpc JSON, wasm circuits binary 500KB+, ws passthrough). Image proxy allowlist works: GET /api/bifrost/v1/_img?u=sol-solana.png -> 200 image/png; disallowed https://example.com/x.png -> 400. GET /api/bifrost/v1/_brand/dk-swap.js -> 200 javascript. /api/ds/tokens?side=source returns tokens list; /api/ds/orders/<bad> -> 404 JSON error, /api/ds/near/orders/<bad> -> 400 JSON error. Darkinator project-token mint HgTGdc29D5bDMrDvsCLnorxz899VyDj7ZN7FPa6vpump is correctly stripped from GET /api/bifrost/v1/indexer/v1/assets (0 occurrences). FRONTEND: Root / loads the Darkinator app (not an iframe), address bar stays '/'. document.title='Darkinator App'; body.innerText contains 'Darkinator', 0 case-sensitive 'Veil' hits, no 'ContractWolf'. Sidebar nav.side has injected items with correct data-testids: dk-nav-private, dk-nav-privacy, dk-nav-track right after DarkinatorSwap. Clicking dk-nav-private -> URL '/#private-route'; dk-swap-card renders with full segmented control (dk-seg-private/privacy/track), dk-amount, dk-out, dk-dest, dk-submit, dk-pick-source (SOL preselected, 'Solana'), dk-pick-destination. Native nav item 'Private route' is highlighted; native Veil main view is hidden while active. Token modal dk-token-modal opens on dk-pick-destination with dk-token-search; chain grid shows 10 tiles (All chains + 9 chains including Ethereum). All 100 visible token row <img.m> served via /api/bifrost/v1/_img proxy (63 of first 100 fully loaded within the wait window — upstream CDN rate). Private route live quote flow: picked Ethereum USDC via search -> amount 2 -> dest 0x68b3a9f8940f418e8051ebb659e8ed278fea41f6 -> 3 route rows (dk-route-0..2) with 'Best' tag, dk-out '213.2859' USDC, 'Live · new in 49s' countdown. CTA 'Review swap' enabled. Clicking submit created REAL order (no funds moved) -> dk-order-modal with dk-order-id '61hUiGfvzqWsKJBRY3r3sj' (visible). dk-order-track navigates to '/#track/61hUiGfvzqWsKJBRY3r3sj' showing dk-track-status card. Direct /#track also shows dk-track-input + dk-track-btn with recent orders section. Legacy URLs: /swap -> '/#private-route' (verified), /track?id=abc -> '/#track/abc' (verified). /about: Darkinator-branded landing, 0 Veil hits, no ContractWolf text. Privacy swap: /#privacy-swap shows dk-swap-card with SOL preselected, dk-refund input visible, dk-dest + dk-submit present.

integration_issues.issue: After entering a known-bad id (e.g. 'garbage123xyz') and clicking Track, dk-track-error did not render during the 6s observation window (backend correctly returned 404/400 for both /api/ds/orders/<id> and /api/ds/near/orders/<id>). Possibly a timing/state issue where T.err is cleared or render is skipped. The happy-path (valid id) works fine.

design_issues.screen: Buy token modal — chain tiles grid
issues: Chain tiles are hard-capped to 9 chains (slice(0,9)) in insertion order from the token list. On first open Ethereum ends up as the 10th/last tile and Base/Arbitrum are not visible as quick tiles — users must use search. Review request implies the preferred common chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana...) should surface near the top. Consider pinning a preferred-chain list ahead of the discovery-order list.

action_items: Minor: investigate why dk-track-error does not render on invalid order ID submissions (upstream clearly returns 404/400 — likely the client swallows the error or short-circuits before setting T.err).
Nice-to-have: prioritise common chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BSC, Solana, Avalanche) in the destination chain-tiles grid so users don't have to search for mainstream L1/L2s.
critical_code_review_comments: dk-swap.js L569: `var tiles = ['All'].concat(chains).slice(0, 9);` caps tile count without any priority ordering, so important EVM chains (Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum) can be excluded on first render depending on upstream token list order.
The /#private-route page produces ~70 console 404s per load (upstream missing assets from app.veilit.xyz). Non-blocking but noisy; worth suppressing or filtering optional asset probes in the shim.

doTrack: `api.getOrder(id).catch(function(){return api.nGetOrder(id);})` — if the nGetOrder promise rejects synchronously inside the catch handler, the outer chain still receives the rejection, which looks correct; but observed behaviour suggests T.err is not reaching the UI for bad ids. Add a defensive `T.err = T.err || 'Order not found'` fallback.
File size: /app/backend/brand/dk-swap.js is ~830 lines in a single IIFE — functional but worth splitting (CSS block, token modal, order modal, routing) for maintainability.

The Darkinator swap widget is loaded by /api/bifrost/v1/_brand/dk-swap.js (defer-injected in HTML head by bifrost_brand.head_inject when target='app'). All interactive elements have data-testid: dk-nav-{private,privacy,track}, dk-swap-card, dk-seg-{private,privacy,track}, dk-amount, dk-out, dk-dest, dk-refund, dk-pick-{source,destination}, dk-token-modal, dk-token-search, dk-modal-close, dk-route-0..N, dk-submit, dk-order-modal, dk-order-id, dk-order-track, dk-track-input, dk-track-btn, dk-track-status, dk-track-error. For destination token selection use search (chain tile grid is capped to 9 chains in token-order insertion). Allow 10-13s after dest+amount for live quote. Avoid f-strings with backslashes in Playwright scripts.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Both reported items are minor: (1) chain-tile UX ordering (design nit — code review comment above), (2) a missing-error-state render in the Track view for invalid order IDs (needs a 1-line defensive fallback in doTrack).
